step1_analysis.description: A bias generation circuit that provides a baseline current via N3 and an additional switchable compensation current via N2. N1 acts as a switch to disable the compensation current by pulling the gate of N2 to ground, allowing dynamic adjustment of the bias voltage (V_B).

paper_reference.title: A 13.56MHz Fully Integrated 1X/2X Active Rectifier with Compensated Bias Current for Inductively Powered Devices

I_bias_total.description: Total bias current when compensation is active (V1=0V, V2=0.6V, V3=0.6V)

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on square law for W/L=10 and Vov=0.18V for both N2 and N3.

I_bias_base.description: Baseline bias current when compensation is disabled (V1=1.8V, V2 pulled low, V3=0.6V)

sky130_expected.calculation: Id_n3 ≈ 43uA (N2 is turned off by N1)
sky130_expected.reasoning: Only N3 contributes to the bias current when N1 pulls V_2 to ground.

V_B_active.description: Generated bias voltage when compensation is active

V_B_base.description: Generated bias voltage when compensation is disabled

Power_consumption.description: Power consumption of the bias circuit

sky130_expected.reasoning: Power is dominated by the bias current drawn from VDD.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure the bias current and voltage in both active and disabled compensation states. V_2 is driven through a resistor to allow N1 to pull it down.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Compensated Bias Current Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm_n3=5u L_xm_n3=0.5u
.param W_xm_n2=5u L_xm_n2=0.5u
.param W_xm_n1=5u L_xm_n1=0.5u
.param W_xm_p1=5u L_xm_p1=0.5u

XM_N3 V_B V_3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm_n3} w={W_xm_n3}
XM_N2 V_B V_2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm_n2} w={W_xm_n2}
XM_N1 V_2 V_1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm_n1} w={W_xm_n1}
XM_P1 V_B V_B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm_p1} w={W_xm_p1}

* Power Supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* Input Stimulus
V3 V_3 0 0.6
V2_drv V_2_drv 0 0.6
R2 V_2_drv V_2 10k
V1 V_1 0 pwl(0 0 1u 0 1.01u 1.8 2u 1.8)

.control
tran 10n 2u

* Measure at t=0.5u (Compensation Active, V1=0V)
meas tran I_vdd_active find i(VVDD) at=0.5u
meas tran V_B_active find v(V_B) at=0.5u
meas tran V_2_active find v(V_2) at=0.5u

* Measure at t=1.5u (Compensation Disabled, V1=1.8V)
meas tran I_vdd_base find i(VVDD) at=1.5u
meas tran V_B_base find v(V_B) at=1.5u
meas tran V_2_disabled find v(V_2) at=1.5u

quit
.endc
.end
